_README: The parish calendar, once. Every place on this site that shows a service or a parish event is rendered from this file by `npm run parish` — the month grid on calendar.html, 'This week at Nativity' on for-our-parish.html, and 'The next few weeks' on parish-life.html. Before this file existed those three lists were hand-copied, and two of them had already drifted: parish-life.html showed the Sunday Liturgy at 9:00 a.m. (the parish confirmed 10:00) and gave 14 and 15 August the wrong weekday names. Edit the calendar HERE and nowhere else, then run `npm run parish`.

_fields.date: REQUIRED. ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Read as a local date, never UTC.
_fields.name: REQUIRED. What to call it in a list — 'Divine Liturgy', 'Dormition of the Theotokos'.
_fields.service: Optional. The service celebrated, when `name` is the feast rather than the service.
_fields.time: Optional display string, exactly as it should read: '9:00 a.m.'. Omit when the time is genuinely not known — do not guess one.
_fields.short: Optional. The compact label for the month grid, where a cell is about 20 characters wide. Derived from `name` and `time` when omitted.
_fields.note: Optional one-line context shown under the name in the week lists. Not shown in the month grid.
_fields.location: Optional. Shown only when it is not the church itself — 'Parish hall', 'Fellowship hall'.
_fields.kind: REQUIRED. 'service' for a divine service, 'parish' for a meeting, class, meal or other parish activity. This is what the two lists colour-code and label.
_fields.verify: Optional. true adds a TODO: verify marker to every rendering of this event. Use it for anything not confirmed by the parish — see data/parish-facts.json.

_addingAnEvent: Add an object to `events`, keep the array sorted by date, run `npm run parish`, then `npm run lint`. An event whose date has passed is dropped from the two week lists automatically but stays in the month grid, which is a record of the month.

events.note: Coffee hour in the parish hall afterwards.

_terminology: The post-Liturgy fellowship is 'coffee hour'. data/site.json makes that canonical and `npm run lint` fails any page that calls it 'the Agape Meal', so do not reintroduce that wording here — it would be rendered into three pages at once.
_noParishEventsYet: Every event above is a divine service, because a divine service is all the parish calendar currently records. All three renderings distinguish `kind: "parish"` — a meeting, a class, a parish meal, a ministry night: the month grid gives it a gold rule plus a spoken label, and the week lists name it in words. Nothing of that kind has been invented to demonstrate it. Add the real ones and they appear in all three places at once.

_provenance.monthGrid: Transcribed from the August 2026 grid that was hand-written into calendar.html, with one correction: the Sunday cells said 'Divine Liturgy 9a'. The parish confirmed on 2026-08-08 that Sunday is Orthros at 9:00 and Divine Liturgy at 10:00 (data/parish-facts.json -> sundayServices), and calendar.html's own sidebar has said so since. The Sunday cells were the last place still showing the compressed single 9:00 service.
_provenance.feastTimes: Every feast-day and weekday service here is tagged verify:true. parish-facts.json -> sundayServices is explicit that the parish's confirmation covers Sunday only, and the 'Great Feasts' line on the calendar sidebar has carried a TODO: verify marker throughout.
